The official rule list names colour change, rotation about the symbol own axis, vertical/horizontal/diagonal movement, x+1 acceleration, and bouncing off or travelling along a boundary — and nothing else. The mechanic was admitted to FS_CONTRACT.allowed without official support. Quarantined rather than retired: if a future re-date of the preparatory PDF documents it, this lifts in one line.

Retired as non-discriminating, not as incorrect. Two independent adjudication rounds agreed with its key. Both ablation halves answered it with no source at all — Claude Sonnet 5 on 7 September, Claude Opus 5 on 8 September at high confidence — and the Opus round rated it decisively leaked by q1 and q2: q2 shows numerically that twenty units inside one calendar year move the rebate by roughly 1,600 euros, which eliminates the "timing does not matter" option outright, and q1 shows the per-unit rate rising with the year’s total, which is the rest of the argument. An item answerable without the pack and readable off its siblings adds nothing. Reworking it as a computation was rejected: every numeric option in this pack is a unit count times a band rate, so a further numeric item would expose one more point on the rate ladder the Opus round showed is already recoverable across siblings. The id is reserved and never reused.

Decisively coupled to its siblings. q2 fixes the thermocline as a sharp temperature band and q3’s stem asserts winter uniformity, so the summer profile’s downward shape is available without the figure or the text. Every option is a depth, so the item reduces to choosing the deepest. The 14 November edit replaced "none of the depths shown" with "at the surface" and made this worse, not better: it removed the only option outside the depth ordering. No key is wrong — the independent re-answer agreed with it at high confidence — and there is no ambiguity finding against it. The repair needed is a profile that is not monotone in depth, so that "deepest" stops being a winning guess, and that is a new figure and a new item rather than an edit to this one. Retired rather than rewritten against a deadline. Id reserved, never reused.
